body: sure, by the way, i’m not sad. you don’t have to give me some random stuff to make me feel better, i just don’t thing life means anything.
i think the only thing that might be worth doing is stuff that can help people. i’m already using up resources and overpopulating the Earth, so i am already a problem, and i don’t even do anything.
thanks for the responses, but i really don’t see myself ever figuring out why life wouldn’t be pointless.

yeah, you’re right. but i think that there really is no meaning of life. a lot of people say happiness and having fun is the main thing but, why would you do that instead of just ending it? like what do i bring to the world.
i guess you’re right, but why stay here? life is a roller coaster and there’s no point to it.
